info_cost.evidence_source: In the Hidden Information condition, subjects are informed of how the payoffs depend on the state and are informed that there is an equal chance that they have been assigned to either state. They are then asked whether they would like to: (i) choose Option A, (ii) choose Option B, or (iii) reveal which state they are in before choosing between Option A and Option B. While subjects avoid information if they choose (i) or (ii), subjects acquire information (i.e., reveal the state) if they choose (iii).
